atoms.text: It’s Jessica’s first day at the supermarket. She has to serve customers.
Look! Her first customer. He’s bringing his shopping to the till.

instruction.text: First, Jessica has to work out how much the shopping costs. Can you help her?
This is Kevin’s shopping. How much does it cost?

hint.text: Solve the addition <mat>30+16</mat> to work out the total cost.
hint.sound: Solve the addition 30 plus 16 to work out the total cost.

instruction.text: Now Jessica has to give Kevin change. His shopping costs 46p. He pays with a £1 coin. How much change should Jessica give to Kevin?

hint.text: Solve the subtraction <mat>100-46</mat> to work out the change.
hint.sound: Solve the subtraction 100 minus 46 to work out the change.

instruction.text: It’s getting busy at the shop. Help Jessica by working out how much each customer’s shopping costs and how much change to give them.
How much does the shopping cost? Select the correct amount.

hint.text: Solve the addition <mat>60+40</mat> to work out the total cost.
hint.sound: Solve the addition 60 plus 40 to work out the total cost.

instruction.text: The shopping costs £1, and the customer pays with a £5 note. How much change should Jessica give to the customer?
instruction.sound: The shopping costs £1, and the customer pays with a five pound note. How much change should Jessica give to the customer?

hint.text: Solve the subtraction <mat>5-1</mat> to work out the change.
hint.sound: Solve the subtraction 5 minus 1 to work out the change.

instruction.text: How much does the shopping cost? Select the correct amount.

hint.text: Solve the addition <mat>2+1</mat> to work out the total cost.
hint.sound: Solve the addition 2 plus 1 to work out the total cost.

instruction.text: The shopping costs £3, and the customer pays with a £5 note. How much change should Jessica give to the customer?
instruction.sound: The shopping costs £3, and the customer pays with a five pound note. How much change should Jessica give to the customer?

hint.text: Solve the subtraction <mat>5-3</mat> to work out the change.
hint.sound: Solve the subtraction 5 minus 3 to work out the change.

instruction.text: How much does the shopping cost? Select the correct amount.

hint.text: Solve the addition <mat>2+2</mat> to work out the total cost.
hint.sound: Solve the addition 2 plus 2 to work out the total cost.

instruction.text: The shopping costs £4, and the customer pays with a £10 note. How much change should Jessica give to the customer?
instruction.sound: The shopping costs £4, and the customer pays with a 10 pound note. How much change should Jessica give to the customer?

hint.text: Solve the subtraction <mat>10-4</mat> to work out the change.
hint.sound: Solve the subtraction 10 minus 4 to work out the change.

atoms.text: You’ve been really helpful. Now Jessica can go home after a great first day!
